tables.name: v2/simple-append-parquet-data
tables.description: Flat schema of long, string and timestamptz. Two appends, four rows, one null.

tables.name: v2/nested-types-parquet-data
tables.description: Struct, list and map, so every nested id space appears. One snapshot, four rows: populated containers, null containers, empty containers, and a null list element and null map value.

tables.name: v1/partitioned-parquet-data
tables.description: Identity partition on category and a day transform on event_ts. Two snapshots, one data file per partition, three rows.

tables.name: v2/partitioned-parquet-data
tables.description: Identity partition on category and a day transform on event_ts. Two snapshots, one data file per partition, three rows.

tables.name: v3/deletion-vector-parquet-data
tables.description: Flat schema of long, string and int. One append of two data files (five and two rows), then a deletion vector that deletes positions 0 and 3 of the first file only.

tables.name: v3/initial-default-parquet-data
tables.description: A required int added with an initial-default (42) whose write-default is then changed (10), an optional string added with an initial-default ("none"), and an optional string added without a default, after the first append. Two snapshots, four rows; rows written before the change read the initial-defaults and null.

tables.name: v2/partial-field-ids-parquet-data
tables.written-by: Iceberg Java 1.11.0, reference-tables generator (parquet-mr data file)
tables.description: Name mapping set, and one Parquet data file with field IDs on its top-level columns and struct fields but not on its list element, map key or map value. One snapshot, three rows; the list, map and absent column read as null.
